rationale: In the middle campaign, the incumbent-to-GP-maximum gap is 1.64, median uncertainty is 1.68, 147 scaffolds have been observed, the last batch mean was 7.66. This supports a mixed batch with an exploration majority while preserving the available hedge channels.
